# Demo run

*Generated by `python demo.py`. Synthetic data; mock API with chaos turned on.*

Chaos settings: 12 requests/second limit, 5% server errors,
2% slow responses (3s against a 2s client timeout),
5% overlapping pages, tokens expiring after 20s while advertising
30s, 7-day maximum date range, and a new field (`booking_channel`) appearing mid-history.
